newsitem.title: USA: Magnum Hunter increases capital budget.
newsitem.headline: Magnum Hunter increases capital budget.

text.p: Magnum Hunter Resources Inc said on Wednesday that its directors approved a $5 million increase in the company's existing budget to $20 million for fiscal 1997.
The company said the increase will fund additional capital costs required in development projects in connection with its recent $133 million Permian Basin acquisition.

Included in the budget is the development of six waterflood projects located in West Texas and the drilling of a minimum of 40 wells this year on the company's Panoma properties, Magnum Hunter said in a statement.
